published_resources.title: AI property briefs: A tidy property brief still needs evidence.
published_resources.description: Attach a source trail to each important claim and keep gaps visible.

published_resources.title: Dubai broker verification: A business card is a starting point.
published_resources.description: Check the official broker record, then separately check the property and transaction.

published_resources.title: Dubai procedure status: Submitted is a stage, not the finish.
published_resources.description: Report the observed procedure status, not the outcome you expected.

published_resources.title: Dubai project status: Find the project behind the brochure.
published_resources.description: Match the registered project before interpreting the progress reported for that exact project.

published_resources.title: Dubai rental index: Same area does not mean same building.
published_resources.description: Keep asking rents, property details and the official index result clearly labelled.

published_resources.title: Dubai property valuation: Ask what produced the property number.
published_resources.description: Name the evidence type, source and purpose before comparing property values.

published_resources.title: An AI factory needs more than GPUs.
published_resources.description: NVIDIA announced Minerva, an AIOps platform connecting infrastructure and workload signals. The trend is visibility across the whole operation.

published_resources.title: More AI calls do not prove more useful work.
published_resources.description: GitHub has expanded Copilot usage reporting across tools. That helps show activity. It does not measure business results by itself.

published_resources.title: AI agents are learning when to ask.
published_resources.description: GitHub has made assisted permissions generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code. The useful question is what still needs your approval.

published_resources.title: A business hub is not a business autopilot.
published_resources.description: Google announced a Gemini landing page for small businesses, with brand, finance and connected-app tools. Start with the workflow you need.

published_resources.title: A chat request is not a shipped fix.
published_resources.description: GitHub announced a consolidated Teams app that connects issue notifications with Copilot. The review step still belongs in the workflow.

published_resources.title: A simulated world is still a test environment.
published_resources.description: NVIDIA expanded Cosmos with data, training and simulation tools for physical AI. Generated scenarios can broaden what developers test.

published_resources.title: More agents. The same queue.
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: In a fictional dispatch library, adding more helpers does not shorten the queue: every independent task waits for the same key. The illustration asks where work must be coordinated and where it can proceed independently.

published_resources.title: AI agents: ability is not authority
published_resources.description: Watch Ahmadreza Samadi’s English film: a fictional invoice explains the boundaries between reading, drafting and approval in business AI.

published_resources.title: AI agents need shared notes, and a way to check them
published_resources.description: Watch Ahmadreza Samadi’s English film: a fictional repair workshop explains shared agent knowledge, context checks and private project information.

published_resources.title: Why does AI sound so confident when it is wrong?
published_resources.description: By Ahmadreza Samadi. An animated fictional museum example explains confident AI mistakes and how to check evidence. English narration and captions.

published_resources.title: AI wrote the result. People still need to understand it.
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: Zara, a fictional research coordinator, receives an AI-generated result. A polished answer alone does not explain which assumptions support it, what was checked, or what its limitations mean.

published_resources.title: A beautiful building model can still be out of date
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: In a fictional office, Omar sees a polished building model while a room feels wrong. The useful question is not how realistic the model looks. It is which physical asset the data describes and when that data was observed.

published_resources.title: Before buying a new machine, find where the energy goes
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: Mira, a fictional building manager, sees a high energy bill and wants new equipment. Instead of choosing a machine from one number, she asks for the building assets and operations to be assessed.

published_resources.title: The AI demo passed. The real work did not.
published_resources.description: Watch Ahmadreza Samadi’s English film about AI evaluation: a polished demo is not proof of task reliability; choose cases that reflect the work.

published_resources.title: The sale happened. The cash is still on its way.
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: Sales alone do not tell Sami how much cash is available today.

published_resources.title: Why does your phone stop charging at 80%?
published_resources.description: By Ahmadreza Samadi. An animated explanation of charge limits, learned charging routines and heat pauses. English narration and captions.

published_resources.title: The button moved. The AI did not notice.
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: In a fictional parcel studio, Nora asks an AI helper to prepare a label. A panel moves before the click arrives. The cursor moves, but the label is still missing. This illustrates a failure possibility; it is not an observed shipment or product test.

published_resources.title: What does Accept cookies actually mean?
published_resources.description: By Ahmadreza Samadi. An animated explanation of cookie banners and what accepting optional purposes may mean. English narration and captions.

published_resources.title: The money has a project name
published_resources.description: Watch the English film: Fictional buyer Rami sees a beautiful model of an unfinished building. His useful question is not only what it will look like, but which records support the payment instructions. No real project or account is represented here.
